# Hanga Macrame

> Handmade macramé wall art, plant hangers and patterns, hand-knotted by Hanga
> in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. The business is trading; this website is a
> coming-soon placeholder while the full site is built.

## What the business does

Hanga makes hand-knotted macramé: wall hangings, plant hangers, bags, shelves
and ornaments, made to order and as one-off pieces. Alongside the finished
work, Hanga publishes macramé patterns and step-by-step video tutorials, and
sells access to exclusive patterns through Patreon and YouTube memberships.

## Where the work actually lives

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hanga.macrame/): finished pieces and work in progress
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@hangamacrame): step-by-step macramé tutorials
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/hanga.macrame): finished pieces and announcements
- [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/HangaMacrame): exclusive patterns and tutorials
- [Google Business Profile](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xFu1bfcvhmfS2C3cA): location, hours and reviews

## Key facts

- Business name: Hanga Macrame
- Location: Bulevardul 21 Decembrie 1989 140, 400689 Cluj-Napoca, Romania
- Open 09:00-22:00, seven days a week
- Languages: English, Romanian, Hungarian
- Craft: macramé — hand-knotted cotton cord, no weaving or loom work
